name: A-Skip
steps: Stand tall with your elbows bent at 90 degrees and an open running lane ahead of you.
Drive one knee sharply up to hip height with your ankle dorsiflexed while taking a quick springy hop off your standing forefoot.
Snap your raised foot briskly straight down beneath your hip as your opposite knee drives up into the next skip.
Continue alternating smoothly down the lane with crisp opposite arm swing for the target duration.
tips: Stay tall through your torso and drive your foot straight down under your center of mass rather than reaching forward.
Keep your toes pulled upward on the lifted leg and swing your arms smoothly from your shoulders.
